title: Subsidence claim delays raise questions for homeowners
summary:
A London family has been waiting three years for LV= General Insurance to complete repairs following a subsidence claim. The case highlights growing challenges in property insurance as subsidence claims rise across the UK due to drought conditions.

title: Pallas Capital provides £3.9m for Shropshire housing scheme
summary:
Pallas Capital has provided £3.9 million in development finance for a residential scheme near Market Drayton, Shropshire, covering refinancing of the completed first phase and construction funding for the second phase. The 16-month facility is structured at just over 65% loan to gross development value.

title: Flood-risk homes may become uninsurable, warns Aviva
summary:
New homes being constructed in flood-risk areas across England could become uninsurable within decades, according to Amanda Blanc, chief executive of Aviva, Britain's largest insurer. Approximately 115,000 homes are projected to be built in flood zones over the next decade if current construction patterns continue.

title: Essex beach hut sales surge 16 units following heatwave
summary:
Estate agency Boydens has reported selling 16 beach huts in Essex so far this year, with demand accelerating during the summer heatwave period. The sales have been concentrated in coastal locations including Frinton-on-Sea and Walton-on-the-Naze, with prices ranging from £10,000 to £60,000.

title: Nock Deighton acquires Cobb Amos estate agency
summary:
Nock Deighton has acquired rival estate agency Cobb Amos in a transaction that expands its presence across south Shropshire and Herefordshire. The deal follows a period of challenging conditions and increasing operational costs.

title: UK rental sector loses over 500 properties daily in 2026
summary:
The UK private rented sector is losing an average of 505 properties per day in 2026, representing more than three times the rate recorded in 2020. Since the start of the decade, 834,800 properties have exited the sector, representing an 18.6% reduction in rental stock nationally.

title: Property fall-throughs rise 6.6% in second quarter of 2026
summary:
Property fall-throughs increased by 6.6% during the second quarter of 2026, with 71,959 transactions collapsing and total costs rising to £257.9 million. The average cost per fall-through reached £3,584, up 2.8% year-on-year.

title: Garden room installations spark neighbour disputes across UK
summary:
The number of garden rooms and outbuildings installed on residential properties has increased significantly since the pandemic, leading to a corresponding rise in neighbour disputes. The trend has been driven by homeowners seeking dedicated office space, gyms, or additional living areas.

title: London flat values fall below 2017 levels, data shows
summary:
London flats are now valued below 2017 levels on a per square metre basis, according to analysis of more than one million property transactions. Data shows flats are currently priced at £6,639 per square metre, compared to £6,787 nine years ago.
